opportunities.title: Small Grants (UK)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds; applications from individuals are not accepted.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth, education and sport, typically £1,500‑£5,000 per award.

opportunities.title: Small Grants (Japan)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds; applications from individuals are not accepted.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across a wide range of fields, with typical awards £1,500‑£5,000, administered by the Japan office.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record; projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan; early‑career researchers and those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration are encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, for projects up to three years, with funding up to £10,000 per year.
